title: 用鞋边轻轻站
description: 成人在低位大脚点上用内侧鞋边承重，身体靠墙。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands low on a vertical wall, the inside edge of one climbing shoe resting on a generous flat foothold. Show that foot in readable profile while the other foot stays on a broad nearby hold and both hands hold comfortable jugs. The torso remains close to the wall, knee following the toe naturally. Choose a spacious diagonal view that includes the entire body and the easy descent foothold. Use layered cut-paper illustration with crisp overlapping shapes, shallow paper shadows, and cobalt, apricot, and ivory construction. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
